gaps.detail: v1 is diagnostic only: collisions and authentic COTS bindings are unresolved. Do not relabel it.
v1 source has no generated mate connectors. Separate 88-connector construction exceeds 140. Authentic COTS need their own validated datums too.
Current binding requires one actual solid per vendor role. Multi-body vendor imports stop for an explicit native binding and budget revision; no silent body selection or static assembly substitution.
v17 modify has no documented fixed setter. Verify a native fastened-to-assembly-origin recipe, not a static transform.
Generic v17 BTM types do not specify all limits or gear/belt parameters. Verify direction, ratio and moving-carrier behavior in an owned pilot.
v17 publishes the base mate-value type with jsonType, but not concrete rotational value fields. No guessed motion sender is implemented.
Roles are mapped to observed native names. A distinct-role rename API is not documented by the inspected endpoints; no 45-call rename pass is hidden in the estimate.
Source expressions and retained part/mate IDs can be inspected; actual receiver world pose, geometry measurements and independent receiver-control execution still need a validated native check.
No human editability, continuous motion, acquisition, endurance or manufacturing release is claimed.
